## The Agentic SaaS Course

### Overview
A 52-hour interactive course on multi-agent orchestration from first principles. Students progress from understanding tokens and context windows to coordinating agent fleets that build production software. 4 tiers, 4 shipped capstones, 8 principles.

### Course Structure

**Prework** (2 hours, 3 lessons)
Set up environment, install Claude Code, configure MCP servers. Get your first agent running.

**Tier 1 — Understand the Machine** (8 hours, 10 lessons)
You can't orchestrate what you don't understand. Start with tokens, context windows, and how AI agents actually process your intent. Master the tool ladder from paste to MCP server.
- Tokens, context windows, and how agents process intent
- The tool ladder: paste → skill → script → agent → MCP
- Why most people use the wrong tool for the job
- **Capstone**: Agent-built tool deployed to production

**Tier 2 — Direct a Single Agent** (12 hours, 12 lessons)
Direct an AI agent to build a full SaaS product. Write specs that constrain and guide agent output. Verify everything.
- Spec-driven development: write the spec, let the agent build
- Constraining agent output through clear boundaries
- Verification patterns: trust but verify agent code
- **Capstone**: Full SaaS product built via agent direction

**Tier 3 — Orchestrate Multiple Agents** (15 hours, 14 lessons)
Coordinate multiple agents working in parallel on a production system. Split tasks, verify outputs, merge contributions.
- Multi-agent task splitting and parallel coordination
- Cross-agent verification and output merging
- Production monitoring of agent-built systems
- **Capstone**: Live product built by coordinated agent fleet

**Tier 4 — Architect Agent Systems** (15 hours, 12 lessons)
Design the systems that agents build. Evaluate AI-generated architecture decisions. Know when to override.
- Designing architectures for agent-built systems
- Evaluating and overriding agent decisions
- System-level judgment: the skill agents can't replicate
- **Capstone**: System architecture designed for agent workflows

### 8 Principles
The course teaches 8 principles that guide multi-agent orchestration:
- Read Before You Generate
- Spec Before You Build
- Error-First Debugging
- The Tool Ladder
- Own Your Constraints
- Test What Matters
- Ship to Learn
- Taste Is the Moat

### Student Testimonials

"I went from pasting prompts into ChatGPT to running three Claude Code agents in parallel on different parts of my SaaS. The progression from tokens to multi-agent is the real magic." — Alex Chen, Software Engineer

"Tier 1 alone was worth it — I finally understood WHY my agents were losing context. By Tier 3, I was coordinating agents on a live product. Completely transformed how I work." — Sarah Martinez, Indie Developer

"Directing one agent is easy. Orchestrating five on the same codebase without them stepping on each other — that's what this course actually teaches." — Jordan Osei, Full-Stack Developer

## Projects

### Predictive (Augure)
AI-Powered Prediction Platform. Enterprise-grade prediction intelligence platform that models complex interdependencies across 17 life domains. Features a 230-field user profiling system, hierarchical ontology with 1,000+ domain nodes, Monte Carlo simulations, and real-time analytics dashboard. Built entirely solo from architecture through deployment.
- Tech: Next.js, TypeScript, Supabase, PostgreSQL, Python, Vercel
- Metrics: 98 Lighthouse Score, <200ms P95 API Response, 47KB Initial Bundle

### MyUrbanFarm.ai
Urban Farming Management Platform. Comprehensive digital platform connecting urban farmers, corporate sponsors, and administrators to manage sustainable rooftop farming initiatives. Real-time tracking, analytics, and multi-stakeholder collaboration.
- Tech: React, TypeScript, Supabase, Interactive Mapping

### NxSupabase
Official Nx Plugin for Supabase. Streamlines Supabase integration within monorepo environments. Automates database migrations, TypeScript type generation, and local development setup with zero configuration.
- Tech: Nx, TypeScript, Supabase, Docker
